messages:
deploybot: Releasecheck FAILED — env parity: FEATURE_X_ENABLED type mismatch between staging and prod. Blocking canary promotion.

#deploybot: details: staging="true" (string), prod=true (boolean). seen in /services/api/config/env.yaml and /services/api/helm/values.yaml.

alex: ugh. when did that flip? I thought feature flags are templated as bools.

maria: i pushed a quickness fix yesterday that munged the envsubst step for CONFIG_FLAGS, might be that. cc @alex @nikhil

nikhil: can you paste the diff? if it's just quoting it should be quick to revert.

maria: diff snippet:
```\n- FEATURE_X_ENABLED: true\n+ FEATURE_X_ENABLED: "true"\n```

jess: that explains the canary health check failing — healthcheck compares strict booleans. fallback route triggered.

alex: decision time: do we roll forward with a compatibility shim in template or rollback the PR?

release-coordinator: since this blocks canary promotion and it's a type-only regression, prefer a rollback of the PR (safer for release window). We can patch and reapply after window.

maria: rollback LGTM from me. I'll open a revert PR now and tag it for hotpatch priority.

nikhil: if rollback takes >30m we might temporarily relax the canary check to avoid customer impact. @sre-oncall thoughts?

sre-oncall: prefer rollback. relaxing checks increases blast radius. can hold traffic routes until revert lands. I can pause the rollout for 45m.

deploybot: action: release-window paused by @sre-oncall at 1745609898. Canary promotion blocked.

maria: revert PR opened: #4123 — includes test to assert flag types and a small CI lint to catch stringified booleans.

alex: thanks. after revert lands, let's pin the values.yaml to the last-known-good Helm chart (v1.8.2) for this release to avoid accidental templating changes. Add a release note entry: "Pinned values.yaml to v1.8.2 due to feature flag type regression".

release-coordinator: noted. I'll add the release note and set flag in the rollback section of the changelog. Also scheduling a follow-up in Monday's postmortem to tighten env linting.

jess: any secrets or keystore implications? the deploybot mentioned /services/api/config/env.yaml — that file is generated but doesn't contain secrets. quick check: PROD_SECRET_PATH unchanged.

nikhil: double-check: the feature flag parsing happens before secret injection, so no secret exposure risk here.

maria: revert merged at 1745609929, CI green. rolling unpause?

sre-oncall: unpausing rollout at 1745609936. monitoring for healthchecks and metrics.

deploybot: Canary promotion resumed. final state: canary promoted to prod after 5 successful cycles. Block resolved.

alex: postmortem bullets: root cause = envsubst step broke quoting; mitigation = stricter lint, pin values.yaml for release, add unit test for flag types, run deploy check to validate env types; action owner = maria/nikhil.

release-coordinator: I'll capture that and send the release note out with the changelog. :white_check_mark:
